**Direction: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

The character and atmosphere of a place
solution:
The correct answer is **"Ambience."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Ambience"** is a noun that refers to the character and atmosphere of a place. (किसी स्‍थान का वातावरण; परिवेश, माहौल)
 
• It is often used to describe the overall feeling or mood of a setting.
 
 
• **Example**: *The **ambience**__ of the restaurant was cozy and romantic, with dim lighting and soft music.*
 
 
 
• So, the character and atmosphere of a place is called **"Ambience."**
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Haven (Option 1)** refers to a place of safety or refuge. (मनुष्‍यों या पशुओं के लिए सुरक्षित विश्रामस्‍थल)
 
• **Cartography (Option 2)** refers to the science or art of making maps.
 
• **Ligament (Option 3)** refers to a band of tough, fibrous tissue that connects bones or holds organs in place.
